architecture_decision.description: Mutmut retained as production backend behind strict adapter boundary.
architecture_decision.rationale: The hardened MutmutAdapter satisfies 11 of 13 required qualification criteria directly. Two criteria (resume, large_campaign_support) are satisfied through architectural patterns (sharding + persistence) rather than native mutmut features. All critical invariants are enforced at the adapter boundary. Replacing mutmut requires only implementing MutationBackendBase — no downstream changes to Verification Graph, Evidence Architecture, Diagnostic Agent, Strengthening Pipeline, Certification, CI, or CLI.

explicit_limitations.description: mutmut silently skips some Python 3.12+ syntax patterns during discovery (F007). Affected files produce undercounted mutant populations.
explicit_limitations.impact: Mutation score may be slightly inflated for repositories with heavy Python 3.12+ syntax usage.
explicit_limitations.mitigation: Cross-reference candidate count with static analysis estimate. Flag discrepancies >5% as suspect.

explicit_limitations.description: Full repository campaigns exceeding 90 minutes cannot complete in a single CI job without sharding.
explicit_limitations.impact: Authoritative full-campaign measurement requires multi-job sharded execution.
explicit_limitations.mitigation: M44.20 sharding splits campaign into N independent shards, each completing within timeout. Merge produces identical result to sequential execution.

explicit_limitations.description: Tests with global state side effects may produce false KILLED classifications when run in mutation subsets.
explicit_limitations.impact: Intermittent inflation of killed count for components with flaky test interactions.
explicit_limitations.mitigation: M44.13 test selection architecture identifies and isolates flaky tests. Marked tests excluded from mutation scope or run sequentially.

explicit_limitations.description: No native mutmut campaign resume. Interruption recovery relies on shard-level checkpointing.
explicit_limitations.impact: A non-sharded interrupted campaign loses uncompleted mutant work.
explicit_limitations.mitigation: All production campaigns use shard-based execution (M44.20). Individual shard checkpoints are resumable. Non-sharded campaigns are deprecated.

next_steps: M44.31: Execute real repository qualification campaigns (small, medium, previously problematic components)
M44.32: Intentionally interrupt a full campaign and prove resume correctness
M44.33: Evaluate Cosmic Ray as alternative backend (optional, if mutmut limitations become critical)
Integrate orchestrator into verify.py mutation command as the canonical execution path
Deprecate direct mutmut CLI coupling in mutation_runner.py (keep as fallback for backward compatibility)
